questions.q: What percentage of the Edexcel GCSE Music course is composing?
Which is a way to develop a motif?
questions.why: A sequence repeats it at a different pitch.

questions.q: Which criterion rewards dynamics, phrasing and tone in a performance?
questions.why: Expression and interpretation covers shaping the music.

questions.q: State two things you can do to earn higher marks in a composition.
questions.model: Develop ideas rather than repeat them and give a clear structure with contrast; follow the brief and notate dynamics and tempo.
